status_meaning: AMENDED means folded into proposed documents. Product gates are NOT_RUN. Reviews are two passes by the same assistant, not independent external audits.

findings.source_basis: Original CX-36 sections 9–10/29; v0.15 CX-23 and CX-34
findings.finding: The proposal creates compiler/runtime/registry contracts already owned elsewhere. Parallel implementations would diverge.
findings.resolution: CX-23 keeps lifecycle, CX-36 owns naming/source/package contracts, CX-34 registry and CX-11 admission. No synthesized CX-35.

findings.source_basis: Original CX-36 section 3: exact .nps syntax MAY evolve; sections 4–5 package/identity notation
findings.finding: There is not enough syntax, schema, canonicalization or inventory detail to implement compatible loaders.
findings.resolution: Adopt explicit proposed v1 strict JSON .nps plus bounded stored-ZIP .np and machine schemas/reference fixtures.

findings.source_basis: Original CX-36 sections 4–5/9: artifact id/content digest and evaluation receipts bundled with executable identity
findings.finding: An implementation can create self-hash or evaluation-subject cycles and change executable identity after testing.
findings.resolution: Domain-separated manifest digest excludes self id; inventory binds assets; freeze package before evaluation; detached releases bind admission and calibration.

findings.source_basis: Original CX-36 sections 1/6: learned typed output and ValidJson examples
findings.finding: Schema validity can be confused with correct extraction/repair or proof of a refinement.
findings.resolution: Return ProposedValue with separate structure/source/semantic validation and explicit missing/refusal/truncation states.

findings.source_basis: Original CX-36 sections 10/24: combined backend methods and hardware/model-format list
findings.finding: Training privileges, serialization formats and hardware placement are conflated.
findings.resolution: Separate compiler/runtime logical interfaces and negotiated operations; bind one runtime target/profile per executable identity.

findings.source_basis: Original CX-36 sections 14–15/25: applicability must reject OOD and deterministic replay
findings.finding: Perfect OOD recognition and cross-runtime deterministic replay are not established by the source.
findings.resolution: Hard-check known applicability; measure undetected shift; distinguish recorded replay from fresh numerical/statistical reproduction and unavailable replay.

findings.source_basis: Original CX-36 sections 19/33: specialization ladder and first BuildLog pilot
findings.finding: A linear ladder and mandatory model success can displace better exact software or select-only solutions.
findings.resolution: Targets are alternatives. Benchmark parser/select-copy plus learned/generative baselines; rejection is a valid pilot outcome; measure omissions as well as hallucinations.

findings.source_basis: Original CX-36 section 23: validate archive/package without concrete parser policy
findings.finding: Hostile package can use traversal, duplicate members, misleading metadata, executables or unbounded allocation before trust is checked.
findings.resolution: Specify allowlisted stored-ZIP, exact inventory, path/header/type/hash/size checks, staging and isolated trusted loaders; add inert negative fixtures.

findings.source_basis: Original CX-36 sections 4/18/23: embedded evaluation/registry status
findings.finding: Attacker forges PASS/signatures in an otherwise digest-valid package or loads a candidate into active service.
findings.resolution: Integrity is not issuer authentication; detached release with trusted admission, candidate-only isolation and current dispatch status.

findings.source_basis: Original CX-36 sections 11/13/16: optional remote backend and fallback
findings.finding: Compile, download, telemetry or fallback can leak private source after local inference fails, or grant a denied operation under another backend.
findings.resolution: Preparation and invocation have separate grants; external compile/publish explicit; inherited budgets and hard constraints apply to each fallback; offline enforced at host.

findings.source_basis: Original CX-36 sections 12/25: shared-base hot-swap/cache
findings.finding: Concurrent invocations can mix adapters, task prefix state or tenants, while receipts name the old model.
findings.resolution: Per-invocation exact revision binding and scoped caches; immutable in-flight handles, synchronized swaps and negative contamination tests.

findings.source_basis: Original CX-36 sections 16/19/25: fallback and lifecycle
findings.finding: Cycles, timeout retries and ambiguous remote compile completion can multiply cost or double-run work.
findings.resolution: Global request budget, fallback depth/visited set, cancellation receipts, idempotency scope and unknown-result reconciliation.

findings.source_basis: Original CX-36 sections 19/23: previous-good rollback/immutable artifacts
findings.finding: Revocation after validation or a revoked previous-good release can cause unsafe reactivation. Code rollback can be falsely described as reversal of external effects.
findings.resolution: Dispatch checks current release/closure generation; rollback eligibility is checked again; in-flight outcomes reconciled; fail stopped if no eligible target.

findings.source_basis: Original CX-36 sections 15/19/21: calibrated reliability and learning lineage
findings.finding: High self-reported confidence, teacher agreement or leaked examples can be laundered into P(correct) or protected release evidence.
findings.resolution: Name the predicted event/cohort; keep raw score origin and calibration separate; grouped eligible data, non-test fits and selective policy evaluation.

findings.source_basis: Original CX-36 sections 21/25: immutable lineage and replay
findings.finding: Replay requirements can force unauthorized indefinite retention or imply erased payloads remain reproducible.
findings.resolution: Retain authorized minimal evidence, permit scoped tombstones/deletion, mark replay unavailable and invalidate dependent claims as appropriate.

findings.source_basis: Original CX-36 initial BuildLog pilot: preserve source facts
findings.finding: A valid span can point to irrelevant text; a format-correct summary may omit the only causal error or normalize numbers incorrectly.
findings.resolution: Validate snapshot/digest/byte range and exact copying separately from relevance/coverage; retain Unknown and include adversarial distractor/omission fixtures in product plan.

findings.source_basis: Supplied v0.15 AXON_CORTEX_MASTER.md vs individual CX-32/CX-33/CX-34 and manifests
findings.finding: The master mainly contains v0.14 material/counts and only appends a v0.15 summary; a builder reading it misses authoritative new contracts.
findings.resolution: Generate master from every current modular Markdown document with source digests; validator rejects stale derived views.

findings.source_basis: Supplied gate_manifest.json compared to task_manifest.json
findings.finding: Twenty declared acceptance gates have no work package assigned; original validator nevertheless passes.
findings.resolution: Assign each original orphan gate to a concrete task and require zero orphan/unknown gate references.

findings.source_basis: Supplied schemas/PROTOCOLS.md vs CX-32–CX-34 and v0.15 summary
findings.finding: Evidence/causal/scheduler type shapes are not folded into the shared protocols; claims outpace interface definitions.
findings.resolution: Add owner-linked logical record shapes, separate model confidence provenance and wire/source schemas, and require exact protocol linkages.

findings.source_basis: Supplied B116/B118/B141/B143/B148 dependency chains
findings.finding: Early instrumentation/registry work waits on the later learned subsystems it should make possible. No literal cycle, but unnecessary critical-path coupling.
findings.resolution: Decouple incumbent instrumentation and minimal evidence/registry adapters; add bounded release profiles and complete dependency closures.

findings.source_basis: Supplied tools/validate_package.py and validation reports
findings.finding: Validation is largely structural and does not establish generated-view parity, gate coverage, exact examples or complete hash inventory. Published report truncates topological lists.
findings.resolution: New validator checks schemas, source/manifests/views, complete DAGs, task gate ownership, inert example validation and package inventory. Actual mutation tests replace asserted self-test receipts.

findings.source_basis: v0.15 stage labels and broad bootstrap prompts
findings.finding: Contract intake stages, whole-subsystem maturity and optional research can be read as one huge implementation commitment.
findings.resolution: Define contract-vs-task dependencies, exit-task release slices, explicit intake before implementation, and no forced successful research candidate.

findings.source_basis: CX-05/CX-06 and protocols probability origins
findings.finding: Calibration is treated in some notation as a raw source; generic confidence can hide the prediction event.
findings.resolution: Keep generated/token/head distribution origin separate from calibrator, applicability/OOD score and empirical event-specific correctness.

findings.source_basis: CX-31 P0–P5 and prior T0–T5 tiers
findings.finding: Transfer labels can imply an unjustified total ordering from one repo/language/family to all others.
findings.resolution: Report repo/family/language/task novelty as separate dimensions with contamination status, grouped uncertainty and receiving-project admission.

findings.source_basis: CX-24 proposed observe_derived output and semantic composition
findings.finding: Schema/span-correct learned extraction can be stored as observed fact, then support a false verified claim.
findings.resolution: Use ExtractedClaim and explicit source/semantic validation; no strength-upgrade solely from a format receipt.

findings.source_basis: CX-33 counterfactual gate permits validated estimator as realized evidence
findings.finding: A well-calibrated simulated outcome can be labeled realized and feed self-promotion.
findings.resolution: Estimates remain estimates regardless of validation; only actual experiment outcomes receive realized class; distinguish upstream matching from treatment-altered effective input.

findings.source_basis: CX-11/CX-32/CX-34 independent admission and source invalidation
findings.finding: A candidate passes checks against evidence that changes/is revoked before publication or dispatch.
findings.resolution: Snapshot evidence closure and generation; bind subject and deployment target; revalidate eligibility at dispatch and rollback; no stale registry lease.

findings.source_basis: CX-29 early low-risk routing/context policies; CX-13 shadow guarantees
findings.finding: Read-only/shadow can transmit secrets, create persistent state or materially change evaluation context; low-risk label hides deployment consequences.
findings.resolution: Risk is per proposed change/effect/project; no-task-effect shadow has egress/storage/resource grants; mandatory controls prefilter all backend fallbacks.

findings.source_basis: CX-28 context pins, recompute and async selection
findings.finding: Pins exceed budget, recomputation is unavailable/stale, or a delayed context decision drops required evidence.
findings.resolution: Hard pins cannot disappear to make room; stop/escalate on overflow; materialize exact model-visible receipts and revalidate snapshot/authority before use.

findings.source_basis: CX-20/21 locked tests and CX-29 recursive proposals
findings.finding: Repeated aggregate eval feedback can overfit locked tasks despite no raw test access; self-optimization can recursively spend its own budget.
findings.resolution: Protected submission/feedback ledger, role separation, preregistered thresholds, fresh final cohorts when needed; lineage-aware depth/fanout/global budget.

findings.source_basis: CX-27 supervision and baseline builder prompts
findings.finding: Supervisor confidence or inability to find more work becomes completion authority; stop loops or revival defeat operator intent.
findings.resolution: Supervisor only proposes finish; protected evidence required, terminal cancellation latch and bounded intervention/fallback.

findings.source_basis: CX-05 state reuse and earlier model-state discussion
findings.finding: Uniform interfaces can imply question isolation, cross-model cache portability or snapshot/fork guarantees a backend does not implement.
findings.resolution: Negotiated feature profiles, exact model/runtime/prompt/isolation scope and typed unsupported response; no latent-state compiler added by implication.

findings.source_basis: CX-16 MiCode bridge and CX-10 evidence/data trust
findings.finding: First-party imported episodes become treated as authoritative confinement, ground truth or immutable approval.
findings.resolution: Source authentication grants only provenance; local host/validator contracts and bridge versions remain explicit; unsupported stronger semantics refuse.

findings.source_basis: CX-21 whole-system benchmark and new correctness-head decisions
findings.finding: Selecting easy examples/abstaining on the rest inflates retained accuracy and may mask worse system utility.
findings.resolution: Evaluate full operational policy, coverage, fallback cost, abstention, final task evidence and locked thresholds; do not promote from confidence alone.
